[[File:LarsH. avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|LarsH..]]
'''LarsH.''' is a 3-D modeler whose image is used on two [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of LarsH. @ Sketchfab". The credit points to Sketchfab, a site for publishing 3-D models. The credited cards are [[Chimaera (V) (ALT)|•Chimaera (V) (AI)]] and [[Thrawn Pincer|•Thrawn Pincer]], in [[Virtual Set 19]] (released 2022).
